title: Alert Salty Egyptian Salmon Wrap
description: A quick, salty Egyptian-inspired wrap featuring sashimi‑style salmon, wholegrain mustard, and fresh veggies for a dairy‑free crowd‑pleaser.
instructions: Slice the sashimi salmon into 1‑inch strips.
In a small bowl whisk together the wholegrain mustard, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Toss the salmon strips in the mustard sauce until evenly coated.
Warm the whole wheat tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat for 30 seconds each side.
Lay the tortilla flat and spread the mustard‑marinated salmon across the center.
Top the salmon with sliced cucumber, shredded carrot, and chopped parsley.
Drizzle a little extra mustard sauce over the vegetables for extra flavor.
Fold the sides of the tortilla over the filling and roll tightly, then slice the wrap diagonally.
